exposure: administration of intravenous dexmedetomidine in the intraoperative period
cohort: The study included 300 patients who underwent cesarean delivery with single injection or combined spinal epidural anesthesia at Baylor Scott & White Medical Center - Temple in 2023.
finding: Intraoperative administration of intravenous dexmedetomidine and combined spinal epidural anesthesia were associated with increased postoperative opioid consumption following cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that specific intraoperative interventions were associated with increased opioid consumption following cesarean delivery, linking the findings directly to this mode of birth.
